blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas gained a direct spot to the quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 women’s U-23 3×3 basketball competition after beating Malaysia, 17-12, on Wednesday at Kinju Futo Station Square. Kacey dela Rosa showed her might once more while getting offensive help from Maria Pasilang as Gilas replicated what its male counterpart did hours earlier by topping Group C with a perfect 3-0 record. With the sweep of the group stage, Gilas will face the winner of the play-in game between the second placer in Group A […]...
